# truenas_kerberos_config (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS Kerberos configuration (kerberos.config). Takes no arguments: there is exactly one Kerberos configuration per TrueNAS system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `appdefaults_aux` (String) Advanced field for manually setting additional parameters inside the appdefaults section of krb5.conf.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "kerberos_config".
- `libdefaults_aux` (String) Advanced field for manually setting additional parameters inside the libdefaults section of krb5.conf.
